A field guide to an inhabited world · volume VII · the hoofed family

Centaurs

Five hoofed monster girls: a woman's upper body on four legs. Horse, zebra, reindeer, mountain goat and alpaca. Herd animals: they graze, travel together and look after one another, and the right person can earn a place in the herd, and a ride.

I · HarpiesII · Bullywugs & Mucus ToadsIII · NekomataIV · KitsuneV · LamiaVI · ArachneVII · CentaursVIII · MerfolkIX · SlimesX · JackalopesXI · MinotaursXII · MollusksXIII · ElvesXIV · UndeadXV · LizardfolkXVI · DragonsXVII · DevilsXVIII · BugsXIX · Flora
The central similarity

Herd and hoof.

Every centaur lives in a herd with a lead mare, grazes, and runs from danger together. Earning a place in the herd is the bond, and grooming is how herd animals say they trust each other, so the brush is this family's bond action.

  • GroomingUse a brush on her: the strongest bond action of the family (+2, once every few minutes).
  • HerdsThree to six with a lead mare; the herd follows her and flees together.
  • Carry & rideAt high friendship any centaur lets you ride on her back (a saddle makes her faster), wears a chestplate you give her, and gallops beside you, grinning, whenever she sees you sprint.
  • KickNever stand behind a stranger: centaurs kick back at whatever hurts them from behind.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a centaur builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Brushing (+2 every few minutes)
  • Apples, carrots, golden carrots, sugar, hay
  • Walking with her on a lead
  • Keeping her herd safe

What costs trust

  • Hitting her or any of her herd
  • Riding her before she offers
  • Fencing her away from her herd for days

Devoted (60+)

She lets you ride (or carries a chest, for the alpaca). Ridden, each species has its own gift: horse speed, reindeer snow trekking, goat climbing.

Mating & young

FormLive foal. YoungFoal / fawn / kid / cria (1, twins rarely), grown in 5 days. WhereWith her herd. Foals use the adult model at 50% scale with long legs (a leg-scale tweak).

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may lie down beside your bed for the night (a centaur does not fit in it; she folds her legs on the floor beside it). By morning she is expecting.
2. FoalingWhen her time comes she returns to her herd, or to the field you keep her in. A single foal is born (twins one time in ten).
3. The foalFoals stand within minutes on long, wobbly legs and stay at their mother's side, copying what she eats. Each is a foal, fawn, kid or cria depending on the species, in a random colour of it.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

GrazingThey eat grass blocks bare (back to dirt, like sheep), hay bales and flowers, and take apples, carrots, golden carrots and sugar from a hand.
HerdsA herd moves together behind its lead mare. Hurt one and the herd bolts, then the lead mare (and the zebras) turn and kick.
Carry & rideAt high friendship (25) she lets you ride with an empty hand; a saddle makes her faster. A chestplate shows over her torso and adds twice its armour points to her health. Devoted, the alpaca also carries a chest (27 slots).
Running togetherWild or tame, a centaur who sees a player sprint by gallops up beside them and keeps pace with a big smile until they slow down.
Rear kickA mob or player that hits her from behind gets a double-hoof kick: heavy knockback and damage.
LeadA lead on a fond centaur lets her walk with you; the herd follows its lead mare, so leading the lead mare moves the herd.
WeatherThunderstorms spook them; they bunch together and stamp.

Species profiles

Plains & meadowsSpirited · fast

Horse (about 2.4 blocks)

TemperamentFriendly, spirited, curious

Ecology & behaviourThe archetype. Herds of horse centaurs gallop across open plains, graze at dawn and dusk and sleep standing up.

Signature: GallopRidden, she is the fastest mount in the mod (faster than a vanilla horse, slower than an ostrich sprint). Her lead mare leads the whole herd to safety.

Player interactionBrush her and bring apples. Let her come to you before you try a saddle.

Colour variants

Bay (default) · Red-brown coat, black mane, tail and stockingsChestnut · Copper red all overPalomino · Gold coat, cream mane and tailDapple grey · Grey with darker dapplesBlack · Glossy black

Spawns inplains, sunflower_plains, meadow, savanna

DangerLow; kicks if hit from behind.

SavannaWild · fierce

Zebra (about 2.3 blocks)

TemperamentWary, quick-tempered, fiercely loyal

Ecology & behaviourFamously never tamed: she will be your friend, never your mount. The herd's stripes blur together when it runs, and a zebra's kick can break a jaw.

Signature: Dazzle & alarm barkWhen the herd runs, hostile mobs lose track of them (they drop their target). A bonded zebra guards your home: she barks an alarm (a loud call) when hostile mobs come within 16 blocks.

Player interactionEarn her friendship and accept her terms.

Colour variants

Plains (default) · Broad black stripes with grey shadow stripesGrevy's · Fine, narrow stripes, white bellyMountain · Bold stripes with a grid on the rumpGolden · Gold stripes on cream (amelanistic)Quagga · Brown back, stripes only on the front

Spawns insavanna, savanna_plateau, windswept_savanna

DangerModerate: kicks and bites when angry.

Snowy taiga & tundraSteady · migratory

Reindeer (about 2.3 blocks)

TemperamentGentle, steady, patient

Ecology & behaviourBoth sexes of reindeer grow antlers, and the females keep theirs through the winter, which is why she has them. Herds migrate between snowy taiga and open snow, digging through the snow for lichen and moss.

Signature: Snow trekkerNo slowdown on snow or powder snow, for her or her rider. She digs moss, glow lichen and sweet berries out of snow and brings them as presents.

Player interactionBring moss and sweet berries. Walk with the herd.

Colour variants

Spawns insnowy_taiga, snowy_plains, taiga, grove, snowy_slopes

DangerLow.

Mountains & stony peaksBold · climber

Mountain Goat (about 2.1 blocks)

TemperamentBold, stubborn, playful

Ecology & behaviourClimbs cliffs other mobs cannot, on split hooves with soft grippy pads. Butts heads to settle arguments (with other goats, and with you if you are rude).

Signature: Cliff climbing & head buttShe jumps two blocks high and never takes fall damage; ridden, so does her rider. Rude players (and hostile mobs) get rammed, like a vanilla goat but harder.

Player interactionClimb up to her. Bring wheat.

Colour variants

White (default) · White shaggy coat, black hornsAlpine ibex · Grey-brown, ridged hornsChamois · Red-brown with a dark face stripeGrey · Slate greyCream · Cream with darker legs

Spawns instony_peaks, jagged_peaks, snowy_slopes, frozen_peaks, windswept_hills

DangerModerate: the ram.

Windswept hills & meadowsFluffy · opinionated

Alpaca (about 2.05 blocks)

TemperamentGentle, opinionated, hums when content

Ecology & behaviourKept for her fleece in the highlands. Hums to talk to her herd, spits when annoyed (like a llama), and carries loads without complaint.

Signature: Spit, fleece & packShe spits at whoever annoys her (like a llama). Devoted, she carries a chest. Her fleece grows long and can be sheared (wool in her colour) without hurting her bond.

Player interactionNever annoy her, and shear her gently when her fleece is long.

Colour variants

White (default) · White fleeceFawn · Light brown fleeceBrown · Chocolate fleeceBlack · Black fleeceGrey · Silver-grey fleece

Spawns inwindswept_hills, meadow, windswept_gravelly_hills, savanna_plateau

DangerLow: spit.

Jungle & swampGentle · dream-eater

Tapir (about 2.1 blocks)

TemperamentGentle, sleepy, quietly protective

Ecology & behaviourTapirus (Perissodactyla: Tapiridae), the same order as horses, so she belongs with the centaurs. A shy browser of the jungle and swamp who eats fruit and leaves at night. In Japan the tapir became the baku, the eater of nightmares.

Signature: BakuPhantoms never spawn for a player sleeping within 32 blocks of a tapir, and the phantom girl stays away too. She eats the bad dreams.

Player interactionBring melons and apples. Brush her.

Spawns injungle, sparse_jungle, bamboo_jungle, swamp, mangrove_swamp

DangerLow.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Brush grooming (+2)
  • Grazing
  • Herds following a lead mare
  • Rear kick
  • Alpaca: chest pack, fleece shearing, spit
  • Zebra alarm bark and dazzle
  • Reindeer snow trekking and presents
  • Goat climbing, ramming, no fall damage
  • A single foal
  • Riding at high friendship, no saddle needed (a saddle makes her faster); every centaur
  • Chestplates: worn over her torso, add to her health
  • Running along: she gallops beside a sprinting player, grinning

Not yet

  • Thunderstorms spooking the herd
  • Stamina when ridden

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • The moose is dropped: her antlers are male-coded. The reindeer stays because female reindeer grow antlers too.
  • No markhor or bighorn: their spiral horns are male-coded. The mountain goat's short horns are shared by both sexes.
  • A centaur in bed does not fit; she lies down beside it instead (it still counts as sharing the bed).
  • The lower body is a horse-like quadruped rig (legs fl/fr/bl/br), the same for all five.

Open questions

  • Should ridden centaurs have stamina?
  • Should the zebra be rideable for her father only?
